h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Rourkela

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Rourkela

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Rourkela

c: Rourkela grew around its steel plant, and its sectors were planned with parks, playing fields and wide roads. The city is also known for hockey and for its engineering institute. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment to Rourkela for township parks, schools, colleges and residential areas. We build it at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, and send it about 1,280 km by road. Design, roto-moulding and fabrication all happen under one roof, and each piece is inspected before dispatch.

Planned sectors make outdoor gyms easy to place, because most already have a park with a path and some shade. We suggest machines based on who uses each park, then send a layout drawing with clear space marked. After you approve the drawing and quote, we manufacture and dispatch, and our team or a dealer in the east installs the equipment on grouted or self-standing bases.

items.q: Can open gym machines be placed near a sports field?
items.a: Yes, as long as there is enough clear space around each station and balls are unlikely to strike users. We mark safe zones on the layout drawing, and we can suggest a spot away from the main play area.

items.q: What is the Fun Rider used for?
items.a: It is a seated machine where the user pushes and pulls to move the seat, working the arms, back and legs together in one motion.

items.q: What warranty covers the moving parts?
items.a: Springs, bearings and spare parts carry a 1-year warranty. Galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts carry 3 years. Both cover manufacturing defects when maintained as advised.
